before.name: Carlos Jimenez
before.description: Carlos Jimenez is a U.S. citizen arrested after an encounter with federal immigration agents in Ontario, California, on October 30, 2025. He told the court he approached them to warn that children would soon arrive at a nearby school bus stop. An agent shot him in the shoulder; he went to a hospital and was taken into federal custody after treatment. Prosecutors alleged that his reversing vehicle threatened an officer. Jimenez denied the allegation. He was released on October 31 on $10,000 bond with an ankle monitor. In May 2026, the parties disclosed a diversion agreement under which prosecutors could seek dismissal after October 31, 2026. He maintained his not-guilty plea; the agreement did not itself dismiss the case.
